title: This AI Schedules Better Than an Executive Assistant
description:
Link to the Resource Vault: https://thenextnewthing.ai/Resources
(There is also a clickable link in my bio)

Link to the full video: https://youtu.be/tQX7VS8iP4Y 

Hey Noah is an AI scheduling assistant that works entirely through text messages—no app to install. It handles the back-and-forth, follows up when people don’t respond, and gets meetings booked automatically.

Corey Ganim thinks removing all that setup friction could make this one take off.
